title: Gift tracker
sign_up_description: Please enter a name and password.
overview_description: This is an overview of all wish lists. Here you can find information/links and let everyone know you bought an item!
wish_list_description: Dit is je eigen verlanglijst. Je kunt items toevoegen, verwijderen of aanpassen.
ideas_description: This is an overview where you can track all your ideas for gifts. If you tick something off in the overview page, it will also automatically be added here!
gift_popup_create_description: Create a new wish here! Only things with a red star are required.
gift_popup_edit_description: You can edit everything on this item and everything will stay linked!
secret_santa_exclude_hint: Untick anyone who can't join this season. The draw will only be made for the people left in.
secret_santa_confirm_finish: Finish this season's draw? A new season will start, so a new draw can be made.
secret_santa_no_assignment: No draw assignment for you this season.
secret_santa_disabled: Secret Santa is not enabled for this family.
secret_santa_already_drawn: A draw already exists for this season. Finish the season to draw again.
secret_santa_too_few: Not enough family members to draw (need at least 3).
secret_santa_impossible: No valid draw is possible with the current members and partner restrictions.
secret_santa_not_drawn: There is no draw yet for this season.
secret_santa_finished: Season finished! A new draw can now be started.
secret_santa_partners_hint: Partners can't draw each other in the Secret Santa.
secret_santa_partner_same: A person can't be their own partner.
secret_santa_partner_member: Both people must be members of this family.
members_hint: See who's in this family and invite new members.
error_description: Unfortunately, there is either something wrong with this website or I am doing some maintenance!
